name: How does a project manager help keep my project on schedule?

mainEntity.name: How does a project manager help keep my project on schedule?

acceptedAnswer.text: The project manager develops a master schedule, sequences trades, tracks milestones, and adjusts the plan when issues arise, ensuring decisions and approvals happen in time to avoid unnecessary delays.
